module.name: AWS EKS Storage Classes
module.description: Creates Kubernetes storage classes for AWS EBS volumes with different performance tiers (gp3, io2, etc.).

required.reason: Requires EKS cluster for storage class deployment

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Name of the Kubernetes cluster (used for resource identification)

optional.name: enable_gp3
optional.description: Create gp3 storage class (general purpose SSD)

optional.name: enable_io2
optional.description: Create io2 storage class (high-performance IOPS SSD)

optional.name: enable_st1
optional.description: Create st1 storage class (throughput optimized HDD)

optional.name: set_default_storage_class
optional.description: Storage class to set as default (gp3, io2, st1, or none)

optional.name: common_labels
optional.description: Common labels to apply to all storage classes

key_outputs.name: storage_classes_deployed
key_outputs.description: List of deployed storage class names

key_outputs.name: default_storage_class_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the default storage class

key_outputs.name: storage_class_names
key_outputs.description: Map of storage class types to names (gp3, io2, st1)
